basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Represents one bounded movement of a traveller or vehicle from origin to destination, not the planned route or itinerary.
A person trip and a vehicle journey are distinct kinds even when they share legs.
Planned, estimated, predicted and observed times are separately recorded.
Booking and ticket are external evidence, not proof of travel.

may: Register a journey and compose its legs.
mustNot: Infer actual travel or boarding from a ticket or plan alone.
Reroute a vehicle or traveller consequentially without authority.
requiresHuman: Disclosure of live location to third parties.

considerations: Movement traces reveal home, work, health visits and associations.
Live location can enable stalking or harm.
Journey data used for pricing or policing can discriminate.

properties.reason: A journey is an occurrence; distances and times are recorded about it, the vehicles and people carry the physical properties.

items: A journey has an origin, destination, ordered legs, mode, subject and start and end times.
Often confused with a route (path), an itinerary (plan), a service run and a shipment.
Wrong arrival predictions leading to missed connections.
